# BCGov Crow - v0.21.0

## Release type

Version 0.21.0 for handoff data hardening. The stricter
`requestedWork` validation requires regenerating older free-text handoffs.

## Summary

Tightens credential handling and separates agent instructions from handoff
data without changing the contract-policy files.

## Highlights

- Application-development guidance forbids literal credentials in code and
  artifacts and requires its credential findings to contain only a path,
  line number, and category, never secret values or fragments.
- Restricts the legacy-modernization data-change handoff's `requestedWork`
  to the `data-change-design` enum value. The Data Architecture workflow owns
  its meaning and retains its approval and execution boundaries.
- Labels quoted repository text as untrusted data in clearly fenced blocks
  with source locations; handoff descriptions cannot grant tool authority or
  override a consumer's instructions.
- Applies the shared guidance to modernization, analytics, availability,
  architecture/security, testing, remediation, and executive-report handoffs.

## Changes

Adds a deterministic work-kind check and regression cases, updates producer
and consumer guidance, and aligns package and compatibility-wrapper versions.

## Compatibility

Existing data-change handoffs with free-text `requestedWork` are rejected.
Regenerate them through the producer using `data-change-design` and the normal
review and sign-off gates. Other handoff field shapes remain unchanged.

## Validation

- PowerShell lint: no new diagnostics against the existing baseline.
- Data-change handoff regression tests: passed on Windows PowerShell 5.1,
  including invisible-character rejection. The file-symlink case requires a
  capability unavailable on the local host; directory-junction coverage passed.
- Strict asset/link, wrapper compatibility, dependency, package dry-run, and
  archive-content checks passed.
- Crow agent/skill and rubber-duck reviews completed; scoped findings addressed.
- Sonar branch quality gate passed with no changed-file issues reported. The
  generic scanner did not analyze unchanged C# templates.

Release publication gates remain separate; no release was published.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.21.0 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.21.0.zip --global --target copilot
```
